name: mochi-crew
description: A pixel-art cat companion that lives in a side pane and reacts to your real Claude Code session: edits, commands, subagents, turns, tests and bugs, with XP, missions, a session journal, and a session meter for model, context, prompt cache and limits or cost, and a live file tree of where Claude is working, plus a session badge that gives each session its own place for Mochi's desk, tints its Terminal tab and puts a matching emoji in its title, and Mochi Tutor, which quizzes you on the project and on what Claude changed, calling a model only when you press.

tutorModel.title: Tutor model
tutorModel.description: Model for quiz digests, grading and follow-ups. Rounds from a warm chat use the session's own model.

tutorContext.title: Tutor context
tutorContext.description: auto: reuse the chat when its cache may be warm, else a capped digest. digest: always the digest. session: always reuse the chat.
